description: Source code for the Mattermost server API related to reporting, including endpoints for user and post reports, with functions for initializing routes, handling report requests, and cursor-based pagination.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Main API struct with route handlers for reporting endpoints.

methods.name: InitReports
methods.description: Initializes reporting-related routes for the API.

methods.name: getUsersForReporting
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve user reports with permission checks and pagination.

methods.name: getUserCountForReporting
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve count of users matching report criteria.

methods.name: startUsersBatchExport
methods.description: Starts a batch export of user data, permission protected.

methods.name: fillReportingBaseOptions
methods.description: Builds reporting base options from URL query parameters.

methods.name: fillUserReportOptions
methods.description: Builds user report options from URL query parameters with validation.

methods.name: getPostsForReporting
methods.description: Handles POST request for retrieving posts for reporting with cursor-based pagination and permission checks.
